Cc: Procurement <procurement@nebula-ai.com>

Subject: GCP listing + procurement intake for Nebula AI

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineering and product teams were impressed with Redwood's latency story. Procurement asked me to start the formal intake so we can align timelines for a GCP Marketplace listing and the associated commercial terms.

Quick questions to start:
- Do you have a short checklist of artifacts we should prepare for GCP (SOW, pricing SKU map, security docs, partner PO flow)?
- Typical lead time from SOW acceptance to listing go-live?
- Any preferred DocuSign template or fields Redwood needs populated for your side?

I've attached a draft SOW (Nebula-SOW-v1.pdf) and can loop in our procurement lead when helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, Nebula AI
elena.park@nebula-ai.com

Attachments: Nebula-SOW-v1.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing + procurement intake for Nebula AI

Elena — great to hear and thanks for the SOW. Looping in Lauren (marketplace ops) and Aditya (partnerships) to make this smooth. High level next steps from our side: 

1) Intake checklist: I attached the internal checklist we use for GCP listings — pricing SKU map, container image registry access, SOW, security summary, and required metadata (product description, logos). Can you confirm you can share the SKU mapping and container image by next Wed?

2) Security docs: We will share a one-page security summary and the stub for SOC2 artifacts. For anything beyond that (e.g. custom audits) we can coordinate through our security team.

3) Commercials / DocuSign: We prefer DocuSign for SOWs. Aditya — can you confirm the Redwood template fields we need (billing address, PO number, signatory)?

4) Timeline: Typical lead time is 4–6 weeks after SOW + SKU mapping are finalized; may be shorter if GCP approvals are fast.

Proposed quick call tomorrow 10:30am PT to review checklist and timeline. If that works for you I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx
